name: Tailfin
author: Greg DeYoung
description: Tailscale panel with tabbed layout: connection health, preference toggles, exit nodes with suggestions, Mullvad regions, and a searchable machine list. Forked from Omarchy's first-party omarchy.tailscale (MIT).

barWidget.description: Tabbed Tailscale panel: connection state, health warnings, preference toggles, exit nodes (with suggestions), Mullvad regions, searchable machines, Taildrop, and account switching.

schema.label: Show offline machines by default
schema.description: The Machines tab keeps offline machines in a collapsed section; this opens it by default.
